# Logs

ID: `logs`

Unprocessed timber used by the sample sawmill recipe\.

- [Saw planks](../recipes/saw_planks.md)

## Production relationships

- Bake bread \(Bakery\): 1 Flour \+ 1 Logs → 2 Bread\.
- Harvest logs \(Lumber Camp\): No tradeable inputs → 2 Logs\.
- Saw planks \(Sawmill\): 2 Logs → 1 Planks\.
